measurement_source: User physically measured the floor-to-floor rise at both ends of the step; both read 7.5 inches. User specifies practically flat parallel floors.
extent_method: Visible foyer perimeter: upper threshold edge, side boundaries and far door-floor boundary. Project onto measured parallel upper plane, then intersect with admitted PCF coverage hull. Furniture does not select the floor elevation.
limitations: The earlier 0.153 m image-derived riser estimate is not used as the measured rise.
Image annotations and PCF/calibration binding can limit absolute horizontal accuracy.
No phone optical-center path or Noesis person position is used as a fit target.
